source_text: The authenticity of such Hadiths is contested among Hadith scholars; for instance, Muhammad Nasiruddin al-Albani deemed the chain of narration in the Umm Atiyyah report weak (da'if) due to interruptions and unreliable transmitters, rendering it insufficient for deriving binding religious rulings. [41]
